items.title: Curbside
Behind the Counter Score
Total Score
CU1 - Cleanliness: Is the exterior of restaurant clean and free of litter?
CU2 - Cleanliness: Were crew wearing uniforms that were clean and in good condition?
CU3 -Messaging: Were Curbside spaces clearly signposted, easily identifiable and positioned  near restaurant entrance doors and a minimum of two Curbside spaces available??

CU4 - Present : Was Presenter friendly and did they greet you by name  Was presenter wearing a high visibility safety 
vest per safety requirements??
CU 4 - Present : Did Presenter have condiments readily available (in apron, cart, tray, caddy, etc.), and asked if you have everything you need?
Service Time R2P
CU 5 - Speed: Was service time (R2P + Fulfillment) 135 seconds or less? Time starts once the bay number is entered and the button "Done" is clicked, stops when the last item is presented
CU 6 - Accuracy: Did you receive all the food and drink items as ordered and were they served as a full portion?
CU7 - Did you receive all the condiments (if required or requested), along with utensils, napkins, and straws?
CU8 - Quality: Was your sandwich/entrée served neat, at proper temperature, fresh, and did it taste good?
CU9 - Quality: Were the french fries hot, salted, and crisp -OR- hash browns hot and crisp and did they taste good?
CU10 - Quality: Was your drink served neat, at the proper temperature and did it taste good?
CU11 - Quality: Was your dessert/McCafé Bakery served neat, at the proper temperature, and did it taste good?

BC1 - Tempering & Prep: Were product levels sufficient per posted product level charts/eProduction monitor for the volume of business, and were products correctly labeled and within secondary shelf lives?
BC1 - Tempering & Prep: Were products correctly labeled and within secondary shelf lives?
BC2 - MFY: Were UHC product holding times and holding levels being adhered to?
BC3 - Fries/hash browns:  Were french fries/hash browns available to meet demand, following cooking and holding procedures and french fries station set up/maintained correctly?
BC4 - Beverages and Desserts: Were drinks placed on appropriate cart/table identified? Were drinks placed separately, grouped by order and served correctly?
BC5 - Order Assembly: Were orders assembled correctly, once all items were available? Were assembly Stations/Landing Tables utilized appropriately and orders checked for accuracy?
BC6 - General Cleanliness Production and Service Area: Did restaurant display general shift cleanliness in production and service ares?
BC7 - People Positioning: Area employees positioned and adjustments made, as conditions dictate, throughout the shift?

BC9 - Leading Operations: Shift and Area Leaders conduct travel paths, identify danger zones and  take appropriate actions to prioritize & reduce operational barriers to deliver Gold Standard  products and a great customer experience
BC10 - Operational Focus: Was the Shift Leader aware of the restaurant's priorities, goals and progress?
